# Component catalogue

`components.json` is a generated snapshot of the 82 top-level component ZIPs under `current/` in `oorexxapis(20260908-080803).zip` (SHA-256 `aa1709f24b4a8473fcfb99f36c11c4bb718b9ce0e30d7a4f439d5df8cbdfeafb`).

Each row records a stable component ID, exact artifact filename, version hint, SHA-256 of the nested component ZIP, and roll-up member path. MCP project requests and ownership claims are constrained to this catalogue.
